name: Masonry_Panel_straight_none
description: Flat, constant-thickness running-bond exterior masonry panel. Opening configuration: none.
origin_note: Bottom centerline at the start connector. Local +Z is up; dimensions are metres.
opening_construction: Host masonry and structural collision are cut to the outside of the full stone surround. Stone sill, jambs, and lintel fill the rough opening, leaving the listed clear aperture.
limitations: Curve and step modules snap by their endpoint connectors, not a rectangular bounding box.
Structural wall thickness is .35 m; dressed stone projects locally.
Opening values use reference-path stations; on tapered faces these are not face-surface distances.
Window frames, glass, and shutters are excluded; masonry reveals belong to the structural wall.
mesh_optimization: Open-backed embedded brick veneer with explicit single-step chamfer rims; no per-brick bevel modifiers. Closed structural mortar and collision remain. Stone profile chamfers use one segment.
photo_observed_vs_synthesized: Photographed edge profiles, curvature principles, and recess depth guide the finish. Brick bond, exact module proportions, topology, and the four requested opening arrangements are original design synthesis.

observed_cues: Deep rectangular reveals have thin raised perimeter edges.
Projecting sills and flat layered lintel hoods cast sharp shadows.
Large dressed masonry courses are clean, intact, and consistently aligned.
reference_photos.applied_geometry: R02 dressed edges and layered lintel/sill profiles adapted to a flat masonry panel.
reference_photos.interpretation: Original modular masonry adaptation; not a measured reconstruction of the photographed building.

reference_basis: Photographs actually viewed before final geometry refinement.
uv_status: UV0 dominant-axis tiled projection, 2 repeats/metre; intentionally overlapping tiling islands; no UV1 lightmap atlas

lod1.method: Planar/curved exposed brick strips replace bevelled brick veneers; host core, stone dressing, aperture, and silhouette profile retained.
lod1.validation_status: Blender FBX reimport, UV/path/bounds and opening-ray checks passed; Unity transition/performance tuning pending.
